_comment: Reference template for Phase 6 (full-flow) multi-skill scenario derivation. Actual output is in phase-6-summary.json.result.scenario. Single-skill mode (downgraded_single_skill_flow) has a different scenario shape — see verification-method.md § Phase 6.

scenarios._comment: Multi-skill mode=full, default '命令遍历' fallback when no create/delete commands are detected. Each skill contributes its Phase 4 commands in read-order. steps[i].status='pass' is a derivation marker, NOT an execution result.
scenarios.name: 多Skill命令遍历 (N steps)
scenarios.description: 自动推导: 遍历所有 skill 的命令（按 phase-1 capabilities 排序）

scenarios._comment: Multi-skill mode=full, create→query→delete lifecycle scenario. Only triggered when at least one skill has create OR delete capabilities in Phase 1.
scenarios.name: 多Skill资源生命周期 (skill-a, skill-b)
scenarios.description: 自动推导: 依次创建资源 → 查询验证 → 清理释放

notes: All step status values are 'pass' in derivation mode — execution is opt-in via ALLOW_REAL_E2E=1.
skills_involved includes every skill discovered via discover_siblings(), not just those with phase-1 JSON.
Sibling skills without phase-1 JSON (e.g. never individually tested) appear in skills_involved but contribute 0 steps.
